name: publicWeb_getEventRunners
description: Resolves PackTrack runner ids (HC.Hasher.id) to public display names and profile photos for the public-website run map. Unauthenticated. Photo exposure was explicitly approved by James (2026-07-10); IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory must NOT be used to gate it (unimplemented feature, not a consent flag).

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run's public-facing UUID; used as an existence guard so an empty name list is not treated as a 404.

parameters.name: userIds
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited ('|') list of HC.Hasher.id runner ids from the PackTrack position payload.

rowsets.name: EventExistence
rowsets.description: Single { EventFound = 1 } row when the event exists; 0 rows when not found (shim returns 404).

rowsets.name: Runners
rowsets.description: One row per resolved runner; may be empty if no ids match a live hasher.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: Hasher.Photo as-is. May be a blob URL or an app-only 'bundle://avatar-NN' value — web clients must skip non-http(s) values.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never expose additional hasher PII (email etc.) without an explicit decision from James (photo was approved 2026-07-10)
Never use IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory in decision logic — it belongs to the unimplemented Global Hash Directory feature
